item.title: Deputies search for suspects in $700 candy theft in West Baton Rouge
item.description: The West Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office is asking for the public's help identifying two people accused of taking part in a not so sweet theft.

item.title: Community Warrant Resolution Clinic offers Baton Rouge residents a fresh start
item.description: Residents in Baton Rouge can resolve outstanding legal issues without fear of arrest at a Community Warrant Resolution Clinic on March 27, where they can speak with public defenders and explore expungement options.

item.title: Study ranks Louisiana as nation's most stressed state
item.description: Louisiana has been ranked as the most stressed state in the nation, due to its high poverty rate, lack of access to healthcare, and poor mental health.

item.title: Local organization creates 'Baskets of Blessings' for kids of single moms
item.description: Redstick C.A.R.E.S. is spreading Easter joy to local kids through its initiative called Baskets of Blessings.

item.title: Deal emerges to end Homeland Security budget standoff as TSA disruptions deepen
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Senators raced Tuesday to clinch an emerging proposal to end the Homeland Security shutdown by funding much of the department, including the Transportation Security Administration airport workers going without pay, but excluding ICE operations that have been core to the dispute. item.title: Hegseth ousts Army chief of staff
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth asked the Army’s chief of staff, Gen. Randy George, to step down from the post and retire immediately, a Pentagon official told The Hill on Thursday. item.title: LSU golf signee reaches final round of Augusta National Women's Amateur
item.description: A future LSU golf student-athlete is tied for 6th place after the first two rounds of the Augusta National Women's Amateur on Wednesday.

item.title: Trump signs order imposing 100% tariff on brand name drugs
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order on Thursday targeting imported brand name drugs with a 100 percent tariff, citing the U.S.'s "import reliance" as reason for the decision.

item.title: 'Jody's Law' passes House, heads to Senate floor
item.description: A Louisiana bill that would strengthen penalties for hit-and-run crashes passed the House and now reaches the Senate.

item.title: Tiger Woods called Trump before DUI arrest: Report
item.description: Golfer Tiger Woods appears to have called President Trump after his rollover crash in Florida last week, according to body camera footage obtained by multiple outlets Thursday.

item.title: St. Vincent de Paul hosts annual Easter lunch
item.description: St. Vincent de Paul of Baton Rouge will host its annual Easter Sunday Lunch Service to provide a warm meal, fellowship, and a message of hope for those in need in the Baton Rouge community.

item.title: One in critical condition after reported shooting in East Baton Rouge
item.description: Authorities are investigating a reported shooting in East Baton Rouge that left one person in critical condition.

item.title: $2M federal grant boosts safety on Burbank Drive
item.description: The Federal government has allocated $2 million for a safety improvement project on Burbank Drive in St. George, which includes new lighting and improved traffic flow to make the area safer for families visiting the local soccer complex.

item.title: Southern University connection tied to historic NASA Artemis II mission
item.description: A Southern University connection is now part of history, as a Louisiana native helps contribute to NASA’s Artemis II mission — the first crewed journey around the moon in more than 50 years.
